# Sportmonks

> > Sportmonks provides comprehensive sports data APIs covering Football, Cricket, Formula One, and other sports with live scores, statistics, player data, and tournament information.

Sportmonks offers developer-friendly APIs for major football leagues (Premier League, Bundesliga, Serie A, Liga MX), international tournaments (UEFA Euro, Copa America, World Cup), cricket competitions (ODI, Big Bash League), and Formula One racing. The platform serves developers building sports applications with real-time data, historical statistics, and detailed player profiles.

## Key Topics

- Football API
- Sports Data APIs

## Football API - Major Leagues

- [Liga MX Football Data - Sportmonks' Football APIs](https://www.sportmonks.com/football-api/liga-mx-api): Liga MX API with scores, standings, and player data from Mexico
- [Coppa Italia Football Data - Sportmonks' Football APIs](https://www.sportmonks.com/football-api/coppa-italia-api): Coppa Italia knockout tournament API with livescores and stats
- [Russian Premier League Russia - Sportmonks](https://www.sportmonks.com/football-api/premier-league-api-russia): Russian Premier League football data API with stats and standings
- [Keuken Kampioen Divisie - Sportmonks](https://www.sportmonks.com/football-api/keuken-kampioen-divisie-api): Dutch Eerste Divisie football API with stats and schedules
- [All Bundesliga players are available in our Football API](https://www.sportmonks.com/football-api/bundesliga-api/players): Bundesliga player data API including stats for Neuer, Reus, and more

## Football API - International Tournaments

- [Euro 2024 Germany | Sportmonks](https://www.sportmonks.com/football-api/european-championship-api/euro-2024-germany/schedule): Euro 2024 Germany API with livescores, odds, and player profiles
- [EURO 2024 Schedule available in our Football API](https://www.sportmonks.com/football-api/european-championship-api/schedule-2024): Complete EURO 2024 match schedule and fixtures via Football API
- [Complete Copa America Schedule available in our Football API](https://www.sportmonks.com/football-api/copa-america-api/fixtures): Copa America fixtures and historical season data via Football API
- [UEFA Euro Winners - Sportmonks](https://www.sportmonks.com/football-api/european-championship-api/uefa-euro-winners): Historical UEFA Euro tournament winners and championship history

## API Documentation & Tutorials

- [How-to get Copa America data with the Sportmonks' Football API - Sportmonks](https://www.sportmonks.com/blogs/how-to-get-copa-america-data-with-the-sportmonks-football-api): Tutorial for accessing Copa America data via Sportmonks Football API
- [How to build your Qatar World Cup 2022 application - Sportmonks](https://www.sportmonks.com/blogs/how-to-build-your-qatar-world-cup-2022-application): Guide to building World Cup 2022 apps with Sportmonks Football API
- [Ten things your application needs - Sportmonks](https://www.sportmonks.com/blogs/ten-things-your-application-needs): Essential features for sports applications to engage football fans
- [Glossary - Sportmonks](https://www.sportmonks.com/glossary): Sports data terminology and API terms reference guide

## Cricket API

- [One Day International | Cricket API | Sportmonks](https://www.sportmonks.com/cricket-api/one-day-international-api): ODI cricket data API with team status and match information
- [Big Bash League Data | Cricket API by Sportmonks](https://www.sportmonks.com/cricket-api/big-bash-league-api): BBL cricket API with player stats, schedules, and match data

## Other Sports APIs

- [Formula 1 tracks - 2026 season - Sportmonks](https://www.sportmonks.com/formula-one-api/formula-1-tracks-2026-season): Complete F1 2026 season track details from Melbourne to Abu Dhabi
